captions.detailed: A rising security bollard assembly featuring a flush-mounting square black base plate with a centralized circular recess. At the center sits a cylindrical steel post that moves vertically on a prismatic joint from a subterranean gray housing. Encircling the post is an orange protective skirt ring, connected to the base via a black dual-bracket hinge that allows it to fold flat or tilt on a revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a rising security bollard with an integrated hinged skirt. The model must feature a flat square base housing, a central telescoping cylinder representing the steel post, and an outer orange circular skirt ring that pivots on a revolute joint at the housing rim.
captions.factory: Construct a base housing using a thin Box primitive combined with a subterranean Cylinder. Subtract a central cylindrical volume from the base plate to form the recess. Model the telescoping steel post as a Cylinder. Model the protective skirt ring by subtracting a concentric inner cylinder from an outer cylinder, and add small box-like hinge brackets. Define a prismatic joint for the vertical telescoping post and a revolute joint for the hinged skirt ring.
